2608.14227.title: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
2608.14227.paper_summary: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the same vector, the encoder receives identical inputs, so the invariance cannot be attributed to learning. For a normalization that uses each spectrum's own statistics, this happens exactly when one spectrum is a positive multiple of the other plus a constant. Several standard preprocessing operations take that form. The encoder should therefore be measured against the normalization alone, which has no learned parameters. On six Raman evaluation datasets, the model does not measurably outperform its own normalization. It improves on raw spectra, but so does the normalization alone. Training does improve the encoder over random initialization, and a controlled experiment shows that it learns to ignore a transformation only when that transformation reaches it. A numerical test settles which transformations a given normalization removes. Across released systems in five modalities, most normalizations already remove transformations of that form, and several of those systems claim that invariance as learned. Replicating the comparison on two of them shows no gain either.
2608.14227.paper_summary_zh: 預處理不變性是光譜基礎模型的一個吸引人的目標：一個凍結的模型在實驗室以不同方式預處理光譜時應該仍然有用。這通常是通過在一個預處理管道下訓練分類器，並在另一個預處理管道下進行測試來衡量的，保留的準確性被視為學習的證據。我們重新檢視這一解讀，使用拉曼基礎模型作為案例研究。這類模型在應用任何學習參數之前會對其輸入進行正規化。如果該正規化將兩個不同預處理的光譜映射到相同的向量，則編碼器接收相同的輸入，因此不變性不能歸因於學習。對於使用每個光譜自身統計數據的正規化，當一個光譜是另一個光譜的正倍數加上一個常數時，這種情況恰好會發生。幾個標準預處理操作就是這種形式。因此，編碼器應該僅根據正規化進行測量，而正規化本身沒有學習參數。在六個拉曼評估數據集上，模型在可測量上並未超越其自身的正規化。它在原始光譜上有所改善，但正規化本身也有改善。訓練確實使編碼器比隨機初始化有所提升，且一項受控實驗顯示，只有當變換到達編碼器時，它才學會忽略該變換。一個數值測試確定了給定正規化去除哪些變換。在五種模式下釋出的系統中，大多數正規化已經去除了這種形式的變換，且其中幾個系統聲稱這種不變性是學習而來的。在其中兩個系統上重複比較顯示沒有任何增益。
